R308_evidence_summary: R308 FAIL. Biohybrid endothelial monolayer promoted from SC-C (R270 existing candidate).
R309_role: REPAIR CANDIDATE — one repair attempt. Diagnose: mechanism failure vs. implementation failure.
R309_action_plan: Step 1: Diagnose using SIM_FEBIO. Is the failure a monolayer mechanics issue (FEBio soft tissue) or a cell-biology issue (out of mechanical model scope)?
Step 2: If mechanical issue (FEBio can model): repair, re-run. If PASS, proceed through completion pipeline.

Step 3: If cell-biology issue (out of mechanical model scope): document explicitly. May require wet-lab. If wet-lab path credible, document and proceed. If not, P-17 → cemetery. Replacement from reservoir.
R309_target_state: EITHER TECHNOLOGY_TRANSFER_READY (if mechanical fix or wet-lab path) OR CEMETERY (if cell-biology fundamental)
machine_blockers: Diagnosis must clearly separate mechanical vs. cell-biology failure.
